subject: Acceptance bandwidth shift + escalation catalog
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v3 + acceptance pacing concerns

Hi Mateo / Laura —

Quick heads-up from our side: our internal clinical review team flagged a slowdown in evaluation throughput this week (resource conflict with a parallel pilot). That will likely push our acceptance window by ~7–10 business days unless we reallocate reviewers.

We attached our current MAP (MAP_v3.pdf) — you can see the evaluation milestones on page 4. Given the dependency on our SME availability, we need to discuss options: short extension, targeted canary acceptance, or Redwood-provided engineering support during the window.

Can we get a 30-minute call today or tomorrow to run through contingency paths? We want to avoid a hard break in the go-live date but need a pragmatic plan.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Head of Clinical Programs
Zephyr Health
priay.rao@zephyrhealth.com
+1 415 555 0218

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + acceptance pacing concerns

Priya — thanks for the flag and the MAP. I reviewed page 4 and agree the acceptance lane is the pinch point. Quick proposals to keep momentum:

- Short-term: shift the formal acceptance by 10 business days and run a canary acceptance on 20% of the evaluation set during the original window.
- Contingency: Redwood assigns a dedicated inference engineer for two weeks to support the SME handoffs and resolve any integration blockers quickly.
- Procurement/Contract: circulate a minimal SOW amendment for the two-week engineering support (I can attach a draft).

If that sounds reasonable I’ll: (1) draft the SOW addendum and share it with Karthik for procurement, (2) prepare a concise escalation catalog that lists SLAs/response targets for the acceptance window, and (3) propose a 30-minute sync at 4pm PT today (or 10am PT tomorrow).

Attaching a quick SOW_draft.docx (draft) for internal review.

Attachments: SOW_draft.docx (docx)

—Mateo
Sr. Account Lead — Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 650 555 0147

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + acceptance pacing concerns — risk snapshot + staffing ask

Thanks for the clear note, Priya. Quick risk snapshot and proposed mitigations below. I’ll own the canary run operationally if we agree to proceed.

Risk register (short):
- SME bandwidth (High) — impact: delayed acceptance; mitigation: targeted 20% canary and prioritized review queue.
- Integration defects discovered late (Medium) — mitigation: two-week on-call engineer from Redwood + daily triage standup.
- Procurement gating for SOW addendum (Medium) — mitigation: procurement pre-approval checklist submitted to Karthik; we request expedited review.

Operational asks:
1) Priya: confirm the 20% canary evaluation cohorts and whether those artifacts are ready for the original acceptance date.
2) Karthik: can procurement provisionally approve a capped two-week engagement (credit-hold) so we can mobilize engineering immediately? If yes I’ll schedule the canary and lock in daily 30-minute triage slots.

I’m free 4pm PT today for the sync.

—Laura
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zephyrhealth.com>, contracts@procureops.com
Date: 2025-06-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + acceptance pacing concerns — procurement note

Looping procurement here. Short answer: we can provisionally reserve engineering capacity under a capped credit arrangement while we finalize the SOW amendment. Two notes:

- I’ve opened PROC-2112 (link below) and flagged it HIGH priority; expected internal procurement review 2 business days if legal confirms standard limited-liability language.
- If Zephyr can confirm acceptance of a time-and-materials cap (not exceeding $18k for the two-week window), we can start immediately and invoice against the cap.

DocuSign/Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-2112

I’ll escalate to Legal if Priya confirms the cap so we can shorten the lead time.

—Karthik
Head of Procurement — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + acceptance pacing concerns — confirmation

Thanks all — that approach works for us. We confirm:

- Move formal acceptance +10 business days.
- Proceed with 20% canary during the original acceptance window (artifacts confirmed).
- Zephyr accepts the two-week engineering support under a T&M cap of $18k while legal and procurement finalize the SOW amendment.
- We also need the escalation catalog you mentioned (simple matrix: severity, response time, owner). Can you send that today so our PM can triage if the canary surfaces issues?

I’ve attached a short escalation_catalog.xlsx with our preferred owners and contact info. Once you send the final SOW addendum and the escalation matrix, we’ll sign and we can start the canary tomorrow.

Attachments: escalation_catalog.xlsx (xlsx)

—Priya
Head of Clinical Programs
Zephyr Health
